# genesyscloud_authorization_roles_settings (Data Source)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/data-sources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Data source for Genesys Cloud organization authorization role settings. This is a singleton, so no arguments are required.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this data source. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/authorization/roles/settings](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-authorization-roles-settings)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `authorization:settings:view`
* `directory:organization:admin`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `authorization`
* `authorization:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "genesyscloud_authorization_roles_settings" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `authorization_grant_division_aware` (Boolean) Indicates whether division aware enforcement is enabled for authorization grant add and delete.
- `backfill_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the organization is opted in to role backfills.
- `genesys_org_policy_bypass` (Boolean) Indicates whether attribute-based access control policy enforcement is skipped when the organization is on the Genesys bypass list.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
